![The Only Homemade Cold Brew Coffee Recipe You Need - Broma Bakery](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081723-2302-0066-0000-b9108a91c417:4)
Make smooth, low-acidity [cold brew coffee](https://www.google.com/search?q=cold+brew+coffee&kgmid=/g/122z2fx6&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiSz4Hn96qXAxVrq5UCHUH9GzEQ3egRegYIAggMEAY) at home using a simple [Good Food Cold Brew Recipe](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/cold-brew-coffee) method.[[1]](https://ozonecoffee.co.uk/pages/brew-guide-ozone-cold-brew)[[2]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/cold-brew-coffee)

### Ingredients and Ratios

- **Coffee:** 50g of coarse-ground coffee (similar to sea salt or French press grind)
- **Water:** 400ml of cold, filtered water
- **To serve:** Ice, plus extra cold water or milk[[1]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/cold-brew-coffee)[[2]](https://ozonecoffee.co.uk/pages/brew-guide-ozone-cold-brew)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/4W5RQrSSVKg)[[4]](https://support.google.com/knowledgepanel/answer/9787176)

### Step-by-Step Instructions

1. **Combine:** Put the coarse coffee grounds into a glass jar or jug. Pour the cold, filtered water over the grounds.
2. **Stir and Cover:** Stir gently to make sure all the coffee is wet. Cover the container with a lid or a cloth.
3. **Steep:** Place it in the refrigerator (or leave it at room temp) and steep for **12 to 18 hours** (16 hours is ideal).
4. **Strain:** Press through a French press plunger, or pour the liquid through a fine-mesh sieve lined with a paper coffee filter or cheesecloth into a clean jar.
5. **Store:** Keep the concentrated cold brew in a sealed container in the fridge for up to **7 days** (best used within 3 to 4 days).[[1]](https://www.steampunkcoffee.co.uk/blogs/steampunk-coffee-blog/make-cold-brew-at-home-with-no-fancy-equipment)[[2]](https://ozonecoffee.co.uk/pages/brew-guide-ozone-cold-brew)[[3]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/cold-brew-coffee)

### How to Serve

- This makes a **concentrate** , so dilute it before drinking.
- Mix **1 part cold brew concentrate** with **2 parts cold water or milk** over plenty of ice. You can also explore serving ideas like a [Horsham Coffee Roaster Cold Brew Guide](https://www.horshamcoffeeroaster.co.uk/pages/coffee-brewing-guide/cold-brew-brewing-guide) for oat milk or tonic variations.[[1]](https://www.horshamcoffeeroaster.co.uk/pages/coffee-brewing-guide/cold-brew-brewing-guide)[[2]](https://ozonecoffee.co.uk/pages/brew-guide-ozone-cold-brew)[[3]](https://support.google.com/knowledgepanel/answer/9787176)[[4]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/cold-brew-coffee)
